why: B's topology τB = generateFrom 𝓑 is the project's instance on TX (tangentBasis = TfamB, via tangentChartMap_mk_self), so B ⇒ A is direct: continuity of p, openness of TV (a member of the basis 𝓑), metrizable and paracompact are read off B. A ⇒ B fails only on B (2) 'p : TX → X_1 is an OPEN map': the project does not prove it (documented gap G.8) and no conjunct of A gives it. Everything else in B follows from A (A_to_B_of_isOpenMap, which takes openness as an extra hypothesis): Hausdorff from A's continuity of TX → X, '𝓑 is a basis' (also not stated in the project) from the tangent charts being homeomorphisms TV ≅ TO. Openness is true (in a chart p is pr₁ : TO → O₁, and x ↦ Tr(x, h₀) is a continuous section through (x₀, h₀)), so the failure is missing proof, not a mathematical difference.
